num_retailers: <int> Total number of retailers in the supply chain network.
num_warehouses: <int> Total number of warehouses in the supply chain network.
num_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.
retailer_warehouse_assignment: <list[int], length num_retailers> Index of the warehouse that each retailer is assigned to.

warehouse_retailer_sets.{warehouse_index}: <list[int]> Indices of retailers served by this warehouse.

demands: <list[list[int]], shape [num_retailers][num_periods]> Quantity of the item demanded by each retailer in each period.

fixed_costs.plant: <list[int], length num_periods> Fixed setup cost incurred at the plant when it produces in each period.
fixed_costs.warehouses: <list[list[int]], shape [num_warehouses][num_periods]> Fixed setup cost incurred at each warehouse when it receives goods in each period.
fixed_costs.retailers: <list[list[int]], shape [num_retailers][num_periods]> Fixed setup cost incurred at each retailer when it receives goods in each period.

holding_costs.plant: <float> Per-unit cost of holding inventory at the plant at the end of each period.
holding_costs.warehouses: <float> Per-unit cost of holding inventory at any warehouse at the end of each period.
holding_costs.retailers: <list[float], length num_retailers> Per-unit cost of holding inventory at each retailer at the end of each period.
